## How each item is verified

| ID | Method |
|---|---|
| A1 | Fresh browser context per mode (`?lowfx=1&mute=1`, and `?mute=1` in full runs), real-time loop running; wait for phase `title` + 3 s; read `__qs.errors` and page console errors/pageerrors; composited screenshot must not be blank. Boot time vs the 3 s budget is reported (warn only, SwiftShader). |
| A2 | Ending sweep (tests/lib/endings.mjs): each scenario on a freshly loaded page, played from `qs.start` to the ending card with `__qa.tick`; `__qs.errors` and console errors are collected per scenario (all attempts). |
| A3 | One page, 10 rounds: start → retry → rewrite (real UI: preset tab + 写好了 + hold-to-crumple) → title → … Each round throws at crush / floor / trash in turn (perfect, lost, three_pointer sets) and plays to the card. At every card: `renderer.info.memory`, JS heap, errors. Endings are rendered every 1.5 s so `renderer.info.memory` sees real uploads. Leak check: 4 of the rounds are then replayed twice with identical seed + target (content already uploaded); geometries/textures must not grow between the two replay passes (tolerance 2). First-use growth (new characters' faces, lazily built sets) is reported but not a failure. |
| A4 | For every ending in the sweep: `cardChoice("retry")` (falls back to clicking 再来一局) → intro → aim + 0.8 s; compare with the fresh-round aim snapshot taken before the throw: phase/timeScale=1/not paused/cam fp/stage classroom/input enabled/ball held, no new full-screen DOM overlays, top/bottom band not black (letterbox), overall luminance within ±40 % (fade/flash), one render call per frame (no PiP), no HUD line of the fresh view missing (digits and names normalised; new lines such as lecture bubbles are ignored). |
| B1 | Natural real-time mode (rAF loop + SwiftShader rendering), Playwright clicks on visible labels (我是男生/开始/preset title/自己写/写好了), keyboard typing into the textarea, `mouse.down` held until the phase leaves `letter`, one click to skip the intro. Pass 1 uses a preset; then the round is finished (manual fast-forward) and 改写情书 is clicked for pass 2 with custom text. Checks `ctx.round.letter` = exactly what was chosen/typed and phase `aim` with `cam.mode` fp. |
| B2 | Fresh round at aim (teacher forced writing). Playwright `mouse.move` to centre / left / right / top / bottom edges, 1.5 s of game time each (manual stepping). Camera yaw/pitch are read from the rendered camera's world direction. Pass: left > centre > right yaw, top > bottom pitch, yaw range ≥ 40°, pitch range ≥ 20°, \|yaw\| ≤ 90°, pitch within [−60°, 60°]. |
| B3 | Fresh aim round. `document.elementFromPoint` at the press point must be the game canvas. Real `mouse.down` → 0.7 s manual stepping: `aim.charging`, `aim.power` rising, mean camera-local Y of the meshes parented to the camera (FP arms) must rise > 1 cm. `mouse.up` → within 0.2 s ball `flying`, phase `flight`, `ball:launched`; within 0.5 s `cam.mode` = follow; launch heading within 10° of the view yaw. |
| B4 | Fresh aim round, teacher forced `watching`, suspicion 0.6. (1) real right-button hold 1.5 s: `aim.studying`, suspicion falls ≥ 0.15, camera pitch drops (looks at the book). (2) real Space hold, then real LMB press 0.6 s: no charging, power 0; release: no launch. (3) LMB charge then Space mid-charge: `aim:cancel`, release does not throw. |
| B5 | Same seed + same solved throw (first solvable of r0c3 / r0c2 / r1c3 / r0c4 / podium) replayed on fresh pages. Baseline twice (determinism), then real Space+D held from 0.15 s after launch, then Space+A, then KeyC presses. Pass: baselines identical (< 1 cm), Space → timeScale < 0.9 and `ball:willpower {on:true}`, D and A each move the landing ≥ 0.15 m and to opposite sides, each C press changes the follow style (cam:mode event with a different style or camera→ball offset change > 25°). |
| B6 | Aim: real `Escape` press, 1 s of stepping → `ctx.time.now` must not advance, pause menu text visible; resume by clicking 继续 → time advances again. Flight: Escape mid-flight → ball position frozen across 1 s of stepping; resume with Escape. |
| B7 | Fresh round with `roundSeconds: 6`, teacher forced writing, no input. HUD text is sampled at t = 1 s and 3 s (the timer should be visible and change). Step until the ending phase: expect `round:timeout`, `bell`, `endingId` = coward. |
| C1 | Physics sandbox (tests swallow ball:launched/landed so the round stays in aim): quiet class (`setAmbient(false)`), teacher forced writing, wind frozen. For every non-player seat: `solveLaunch(__qs.target(seat))` → `launch` → step until landed. Hit = Landing desk/chair with that seatId. Full run: seeds 11 and 23 (different occupants); quick: seed 11, every 3rd seat. Also reports unsolvable seats and solver-prediction mismatches. |
| C2 | Physics sandbox, quiet class, teacher frozen, wind frozen. Seeded random yaw ∈ [−85°, 85°], pitch ∈ [−15°, 75°], power ∈ [0, 1] via `gameplay.launch`. Every tick: finite pos/vel; centre never leaves the room except through the open window w1 (crossing point checked); never crosses a thin desk/chair/podium/book slab from above its top to below its bottom inside its footprint. `ball:landed` must arrive within 8 s of game time. A fresh round every 50 throws. |
| C3 | Sandbox. (1) A flat throw (pitch ~20°) onto a desk with the full position log: bounce apex heights must decrease, the ball must come to rest (drift < 5 mm over 1 s after ball:landed), roll distance after first contact < 1.5 m; 6 frames from a QA side camera go to qa/shots/C3/ for review. (2) In the normal flow (reactions only run in `flight`), flat throws at the heads of the nearest classmates in front (ballistic aim at the head centre): a `ball:hit` tagged head must occur, the post-hit velocity must point away from the head, and a reaction must follow within 1.5 s (`student:event` or `ai.students.react` for that id, or an expression/clip change visible as a student:event). |
| D1 | Fresh round, AI unforced, player idle looking at the board; observe 60 s of game time (30 s quick). From `teacher:state` events: the sequence must contain writing→warning→watching; every warning lasts 0.5–0.9 s (game time). Tell: during each warning the teacher character gets a clip/emote/lookAt/expression call, a bubble/say, or the head rotates ≥ 4° (visible), and an audio event appears in `ctx.audio.debug.recent` or an `audio.sfx` call (audible). FP screenshots of writing / warning / watching. |
| D2 | Fresh round, teacher forced `watching`, suspicion 0, `ctx.input.simulate({down:"Mouse0"})` held. Measure game time from the first tick where `teacher.canSee(PLAYER_EYE)` (or charging visibility) is true to `teacher:caught`. Repeated for 3 seeds; all must be ≤ 3 s. |
| D3 | Fresh round. (a) teacher forced watching, suspicion 0.6, simulated RMB (study) 1.5 s → must drop ≥ 0.15. (b) teacher forced writing, suspicion 0.2, simulated LMB charging 3 s → must not rise (≤ +0.005); then the charge is cancelled with Space so nothing is thrown. |
| D4 | Fresh round, teacher forced watching, suspicion 0; high lob to a front-row desk / the podium. Counts flight time with `teacher.canSee(ball.pos)`; after landing `ctx.round.teacherSawBall` must be true (and `teacher:caught {reason:"ball"}` emitted). Control: same throw with the teacher forced writing → teacherSawBall false. |
| D5 | Per kind (stretch, raiseHand, standUp, sneeze, catch, witness, gust, teacherTurn), three deterministic flights on fresh pages (seed 24, quiet class, teacher forced writing, lob to the podium; trigger 0.2 s into the flight with no id, so the AI picks the classmate nearest the path): (1) discover who/what is affected from `student:event`/`incident`; (2) control without trigger and (3) with trigger, both rendered by a close QA camera on the affected classmate (or the open window for gust, the teacher for teacherTurn) just before and 0.7 s after the trigger time. Visible = the affected character's maximum bone displacement over those 0.7 s exceeds max(1.5 × control, control + 6 cm) (a pixel metric was too noisy because classmates track the ball with their gaze); gust = `classroom.wind.strength` peak > 0.3 plus a pixel change at the window (wind is not frozen here). Screenshots are for eyeballing. Pass: ≥ 6 kinds return true, emit an event and are visible. Screenshots: qa/shots/D5/<kind>.png (after) and <kind>-before.png. |
| E1 | (1) Ending sweep: one scenario per ending (tests/lib/endings.mjs) with fixed seeds; each attempt checks the physical precondition (e.g. landed on the crush's desk, unseen) and then that `ctx.round.endingId` is the expected ending. >1 attempt needed = unstable (warn). (2) `ctx.story.resolve()` is called on 24 synthetic rounds built from the live roster (all GDD §7 rows + priority edges); strict rows must match, interpretation rows only warn. |
| E2 | From the ending sweep recording (phase `ending` → `card`): game-time duration in [8, 45] s; ≥ 1 dialogue line (`say` event) or caption; camera work = ≥ 1 cut or ≥ 30 frames of camera motion; at least one music track other than classroom/flight/title in `ctx.audio.debug.music` (or an `audio.music` call); card text contains the ending title (the part after ·, the card shows the tag separately). Key frames: the canvas thumbnail at the story climax beat (else +5 s) of every pair of endings must differ (mean abs diff > 6/255). |
| E3 | The sweep's caught_read scenario starts with the custom letter "教室第四排的风都知道，我偷看了你一百零八次<3" (contains "<3" to catch HTML escaping bugs). While the ending plays, the visible DOM text is sampled every 0.1 s; the full normalised letter must appear on screen (typewriter allowed) or in a `say`/`letterReveal` text. Read-aloud evidence: `audio.speak` / speechSynthesis with the full text, or dialogue blips. |
| E4 | Fresh browser context (empty localStorage). Play coward (roundSeconds 3) twice: first card must say NEW and `ending:shown.isNew` true, second must not. Reload: `story.gallery.unlocked()` and localStorage `qingshu.endings` still contain it. On the title screen click 结局图鉴 (fallback `ui.gallery()`): the unlocked title is listed and ≥ 90 % of locked endings show their `hint` text; screenshot. |
| F1 | Every throw of the ending sweep (≈ 11 flights, different targets) is sampled each tick while phase = flight, ball flying and `cam.mode` = follow: the ball centre is projected with the render camera; in-centre = in front and \|ndc x\|,\|y\| ≤ 0.7. Every 3rd frame 5 rays (centre ± ball radius) are cast from the camera against visible opaque meshes: all 5 blocked by something < 1 m from the camera = "hidden by nearby geometry". Also flags the camera inside a static collider box. The camera module's own `cam.metrics` ratio is shown for comparison. |
| F2 | Sweep flights: minimum `engine.timeScale` while the ball flies must be < 0.85. Afterwards: timeScale must be exactly 1 when the ending card is up, and 1 again in the aim phase after 再来一局. |
| F3 | Fresh round, quiet class, teacher forced writing; long lob to the podium; 0.3 s into the flight (a) `ai.students.trigger("teacherTurn")`, (b) in a second run `forceTeacher("watching")`. Within 0.6 s the PiP must be detectable: > 1 renderer.render call per frame, or `cam.debug().pip`, or a `cam.pip(true)` call. Screenshot of the PiP. |
| F4 | Uses the A4 retry snapshots of every ending: `cam.debug()` must be idle: fade/flash/letterbox/vignette/speed lines 0, iris `open`, no PiP/custom render, roll 0, no slow-mo requests, no extra full-screen DOM overlays, composited screenshot luminance within ±40 % of a fresh aim view and no black top/bottom bands. Highlights endings that use irisHeart/fade/flash/letterbox (from the camera call spy). |
| G1 | Drives one round with real UI input and manual time, saving qa/shots/keyframes/*.png: title, letter editor, crumple (mouse held), intro, aim, charging, flight ×3 (launch / apex / descent), landing, settings, gallery, pause; phone 360×640 title/aim/card; normal (non-lowfx) title/aim. Ending frames (+1.5 s, +5 s, card) come from the sweep (qa/shots/endings/). Automatic check: no blank frame (luminance/contrast); the 1–5 scoring per ACCEPTANCE G is done by eye in mode 2. |
| H1 | Unmuted page (`?lowfx=1`). AudioContext instances are tracked from document start. Real click on 我是男生 → context state must be `running`. One round through the real UI (letter, crumple, intro) then scripted aim → throw → ending; `ctx.audio.debug.music` is recorded at every phase change. Expect title→title, aim→classroom, flight→flight, ending→an ending track (romance, comedy, …). Signal level at the destination is sampled (analyser) for information. |
| H2 | Same unmuted round as H1 (real crumple, intro bell, forced teacher warning, charging, throw onto a desk). Every new entry of `ctx.audio.debug.recent` is collected each tick; each required name must appear. Names seen only through `ctx.audio.sfx` call spies (not in debug.recent) give a warning. |
| H3 | Unmuted page. Every connection to the AudioContext destination is routed through a QA analyser (installed before boot). Title → 设置 → the 主音量 slider is set to 0 with a real fill → sfx("ding") + sfx("bell") + title music → peak at the destination must be < 1e-4 over 0.6 s. Sanity: at 0.8 the same sounds must be audible (peak > 1e-3), otherwise the measurement is inconclusive. Reload → `ctx.settings.masterVolume` and localStorage `qingshu.settings` keep 0. Also `?mute=1` boot must be silent and must not persist: reloading the same profile without mute=1 must restore audible volume. |
| I1 | Fresh aim round (ambient on) in lowfx and in normal mode (shadows on); the camera is turned left / centre / right / up with real mouse moves; `__qs.render()` then `__qs.state().drawCalls/triangles` (renderer.info of the last render, shadow passes included). Max over views must be within budget. |
| I2 | lowfx page, manual mode. `engine.tick(1/60)` is timed with performance.now() (yields between ticks are not counted) over 10 s of aim with ambient classmates and the natural teacher, then a full flight, then 8 s of an ending. Reports avg / p95 / max per phase and the slowest update order slot is not measured (contract-level only). Machine-dependent: also compare with `node -e` CPU speed if it fails. |
| J1 | Collects player-facing text: DOM text on title, settings, how-to, letter editor, HUD, pause, gallery; every DOM line, `say` line, caption and reveal seen during the ending sweep; ENDINGS titles/subtitles/hints, letter presets, roster names, blackboard text. Flags placeholder patterns (TODO, stub, lorem, 测试, undefined, NaN, [object …], null) and lines with ≥ 3 consecutive Latin letters that are not whitelisted (NEW, P.S., …). Typos need a human read of qa/data/J1.json. |
| J2 | Collects every ending's script as played (dialogue lines with speakers, captions, letter reveals, music, sets) into qa/data/J2.json together with the +1.5 s / +5 s / card screenshots, for a human one-sentence summary in the report (manual). Automatic part: an ending with no dialogue, caption or reveal at all fails. |

## QA verdict — acceptance round 1 (git `53f0edd`, all nine modules real and committed)

**Verdict: ⚠️ CONDITIONAL — no confirmed product P0 blocker. Not yet a clean release: one P0 item (F1) fails on a real but minor issue, and there are 1 P1 + 6 P2 bugs.**

The auto table above applies the strict rule (any P0 ❌ = not releasable). QA judgement on the auto failures, with evidence:

| Item | Auto | QA judgement | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| A3 | ✅ (latest run) | ✅ | 10/10 rounds, 0 errors. GPU memory is flat when identical rounds are replayed (latest run: 118 geometries / 113 textures across 8 replays). Earlier growth was first-use uploads; the earlier test method was wrong and is fixed. Round 9 once hit BUG-003 (solver null under load); A3 now falls back and reports it. |
| A4 | ✅ (latest run) | ✅ | 13/13 retries clean after the test fix. Before that it was a false positive: It flagged a full-screen `<i>` with a background image but alpha 0 after caught_read, while screenshot `shots/a4/caught_read-retry.png` is clean, and `cam.debug()` is idle (fade 0, letterbox 0, iris open, no PiP, roll 0, timeScale 1). A4 now ignores invisible layers. |
| D5 | ❌ (5/8 auto) | ✅ (7/8 by eye) | All 8 kinds return `true` and emit `student:event`/`incident`. Auto-visible by bone displacement / wind: stretch, raiseHand, standUp, sneeze, gust. By eye: witness (`shots/D5/witness.png`: shock face, "!", sweat) and teacherTurn (`shots/D5/teacherTurn.png`: over-shoulder peek, "?", PiP frame). `catch` shows nothing in this setup because the jock is far from the path; the trigger only arms the reflex. |
| F1 | ❌ | ❌ real, minor (BUG-004) | 100 % of 2218 follow frames are in the central 70 % (camera metrics agree). The only failure: the ball is fully hidden behind the curtains for ~0.1 s while exiting the window. |
| H3 (P1) | ❌ | ❌ real (BUG-002) | `?mute=1` is persisted. Master volume 0 = silence is verified in an isolated run (default peak 0.575 → 0.000 at master 0). Inside the hour-long run the analyser sanity check reads 0 even at default volume, so the silence part is inconclusive there (test environment). |
| C1 | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | 98.2 % (≥ 90 % required). r0c1 is unsolvable / fragile (BUG-001, P1). |
| E1 | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | 13/13 endings and 24/24 resolve rows pass. `perfect` with seed 11 needs a 2nd attempt because of BUG-001. |

### Open bugs by owner (details: `BUGS.md`)

- **qs-gameplay-engineer:** BUG-001 (P1) front-row solver failure; BUG-003 (P2) solver budget is wall-clock, so results depend on load.
- **lead:** BUG-002 (P2) mute persisted (with qs-ui-designer); BUG-007 (P2) the head in front blocks the aim view (with qs-character-artist).
- **qs-camera-director:** BUG-004 (P2) curtains hide the ball (with qs-env-artist); BUG-005 (P2) foreground heads in close-ups.
- **qs-narrative-director:** BUG-006 (P2) the reveal sheet covers the reader's face (with qs-ui-designer).
- **qs-ui-designer:** BUG-008 (P2) phone hints and button overlap; BUG-009 (P3) Latin text.

**Average ≈ 3.7 → G passes narrowly.** No clipping through walls, no missing textures, no tofu glyphs; all Chinese renders. Main weaknesses: occluding foreground heads (aim view and ending close-ups) and the reveal sheet over faces.

### J2 — one-sentence beat per ending (from the played scripts, `data/J2.json`)

- **perfect:** she calls your handwriting ugly but admits she read it many times; rooftop at sunset. Sweet, lands.
- **same_gender:** 江北 solemnly accepts ("我会对你负责的", offers half his drumstick) while you try to explain; a warm mix-up montage. Absurd, kind, never mocking.
- **wrong_caught:** the class monitor reports you; parents in the office; dad says the handwriting is just like his, and mom asks who *he* wrote to. Good escalation.
- **wrong_accept:** the recipient nods "I understand everything"; day 1 / 30 / 100 captions show you never managed to explain. Clear.
- **caught_read:** the teacher makes you read your own letter aloud verbatim; "文笔还行". Social death, clear.
- **chalk_counter:** the teacher compliments your power, then snipes you with chalk ("命中率 100%"). Short (14.9 s) but clear.
- **graded:** the teacher grades the love letter 59 points, one short of passing. Clear.
- **three_pointer:** the commentator and the PE teacher recruit you; the unsent letter becomes a national-final buzzer-beater. Clear and funny.
- **out_window:** the principal reads it over the school PA, "支持你！但要以学业为重". Clear.
- **confetti:** the fan shreds it into heart-shaped "snow"; "……是我的。" Clear but visually weak (see BUG-005).
- **self_love:** you read your own letter and are moved ("原来……我这么会说话"). Clear.
- **lost:** nobody noticed; at night the janitor says "年轻真好啊". Clear and melancholy.
- **coward:** the bell; the ball is soggy with sweat; "明天一定". Clear.

All 13 are understandable in one sentence; tone is PG and school-appropriate.

### Playtest notes (real input, B-series + G1)

- **The loop works end to end with real mouse and keyboard:** title → letter (preset and custom) → hold-to-crumple → intro (click-skip ~0.9 s) → aim → charge → flight → ending → card → 改写情书.
- **Controls:**
  - Charge feel: power eases 0.17 → 0.87 over 0.7 s, the arm lifts 3.5 cm, and the trajectory dots help.
  - Studying drops suspicion from 0.53 to 0 in 1.5 s and looks down at the book (−50°).
  - Holding Space mid-flight gives 0.3× slow motion; A/D move the landing by 1–2.3 m, which is very strong and possibly too easy.
  - C cycles side → stay → cinematic.
- **Things a player may not get:**
  - In the default view the crush's desk is often hidden behind the head in front; you must look up/aside first (BUG-007).
  - A 2.3 m telekinesis drift may make aiming feel optional.
  - Being caught takes only ~2 s of charging in view, which is fair given the clear tells.
- **Not done this round:** three full hand-played rounds with different strategies (normal aim / random throws / never throw). They are covered by automation instead: B1/B3 (normal aim), C2 (200 random throws), B7 (never throw → coward). A human-feel playtest in a real GPU browser is recommended.

### Test-suite notes

- **Determinism:** fixed seeds with replay checks (B5 baseline Δ 0.000 m). Ending scenarios are reproducible on fresh pages; only BUG-001/003 cause retries.
- **Fixed during this round** (wrong-method tests, not product bugs):
  - A3 memory now uses replays;
  - D5 uses a pose metric instead of noisy pixels;
  - A4 ignores invisible layers;
  - E2 card-title matching (the card shows tag + main title separately);
  - CSS settle waits before UI screenshots;
  - H3 sanity retries.
- **Limits:**
  - The H3 analyser sanity check is unreliable late in long runs.
  - The D5 `catch` setup never brings the ball near the jock.
  - SwiftShader timings (boot 4–8 s) are not representative of a real GPU, so A1's boot budget is only a warning.
